purpose: Batch 28 adds three current post-auction available examples using Acuitus property records plus official company and primary operator corroboration. No title, legal-pack, EPC-certificate or exact INSPIRE parcel join is inferred.

candidates.title: Central London freehold retail and office investment entirely let to five tenants
candidates.tenant_summary: Five occupational interests disclosed; Home Vets London Limited and Toby Holdings Ltd were separately checked at Companies House.
candidates.lease_position: The ground-floor cafe lease is stated as 30 years from 12 May 2009; the third-floor lease includes a tenant break on 5 May 2027. Executed leases, arrears, deposits, service charge and current occupation for every tenant were not read.
candidates.planning_position: Acuitus describes future change-of-use potential for the upper floors. No planning application, lawful-use certificate, listed-building record or approved drawing was opened.
candidates.epc_position: Acuitus states the EPC will be in the legal pack. The legal pack and official certificate were not opened.
candidates.occupation_position: Companies House records Home Vets London Limited as active with registered office at 7-8 Little Turnstile. Toby Holdings Ltd is active, but its registered office is elsewhere and its exact occupational interest remains sourced to Acuitus.
risk_notes: guide price is no longer published and the lot remains marked Available after the 16 July 2026 auction
five separate occupational interests create lease, break, service-charge and covenant reconciliation requirements
title register, title plan, legal pack, executed leases, EPC, planning history, rates and exact parcel geometry remain unread

candidates.address: Holland and Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, Clwyd, LL57 1PB
candidates.title: Virtual-freehold town-centre retail investment let to Holland & Barrett Retail Limited
candidates.lease_position: Acuitus states a five-year occupational lease from 24 February 2026, expiring 23 February 2031, with a tenant option to determine on the third anniversary and a three-month rent-free period. Exact rent-free dates are incomplete in the published particulars.

candidates.tenure_conflict: The sale is described as virtual freehold through two 999-year leases, not absolute freehold. Current superior titles and lease plans were not read.
